tex_content.html:
Remark
[Dependence of local-estimate constants] 1. ch8:8.46–8.68\group ch08-generalized-solutions The constants in (8.46), (8.47), and (8.63) are nondecreasing in $ u R$; the constant in (8.65) is nondecreasing in $R_0$; and the exponents in (8.65) and (8.68) are nonincreasing in $ u R_0$ and $ u d'$, respectively. When $ u =0$, these constants and exponents are independent of the displayed radius and hence of the corresponding domains.
